integrity: The proof is elementary and self-contained. The source paper's Section 3 and Conjecture 3.1 were inspected in full-text PDF form; a standalone exact-arithmetic verifier exhaustively checks a broad finite parameter window as a replay aid, not as proof.
limitations: The theorem isolates only the positive-square-discriminant branch of the recent Lucas entry-point bias conjecture. It makes no claim about the nonsquare-discriminant race and no claim of exhaustive bibliographic novelty.
title: Exact onset of the Lucas entry-point bias for square discriminants
